title: Music Space — Doodle video (script + storyboard, bar/beat timeline)
note: Positions are bar:beat (1-based, 4/4). t_s_124 = seconds at 124 BPM with the first downbeat at 0 s. Retime with retime.py.

acts.title: HOOK 钩子
acts.purpose: 8-hit collage of real product moments, then the title 「同一刻，另一面。」 and a match cut into the real landing page
acts.music: cold open, full band from the first frame; unison stab on 4:3.5 then silence; IMPACT on 5:1 (title); tagline pop 6:1; chord rings to 8:4

acts.title: PAIN 痛点
acts.purpose: after the show: only your own angle; the best photo of you is on a stranger's phone; the people next to you are gone; turn: what if it could be swapped back?
acts.music: half-time and sparse from 9:1 (kick on 1, snare on 3); build 19-20 (four-on-the-floor, snare roll, riser) into 21:1

acts.title: ENTER 入场
acts.purpose: the product: back into the same livehouse, your illustrated avatar, choose how to take part, see who was there (labelled 示例)
acts.music: DROP on 21:1: full groove when the product appears; sticker-pop dings on beat 4 of every other bar

acts.title: PHOTO + AI 照片与端侧 AI
acts.purpose: put a photo on the wall: EXIF time, on-device AI suggests the side (人海), honest 不确定, rules group 同一刻 (<=3 min), not AI
acts.music: thinner groove; riser into the AI CHIME on 31:3, groove back from the chime; stamp-thud accent on 39:1

acts.title: SAME MOMENT + EXCHANGE 同一刻与交换
acts.purpose: 同一刻的另一面: you shot the crowd, TA shot the stage; request with consent; pending; 交换已接受 payoff; revocable
acts.music: reveal sting on 41:1; build 41-50 (snare 8ths then 16ths, rising bass, riser) into a one-beat silence on 50:4; PAYOFF hit on 51:1; second groove from 51

acts.title: AFTER THE SWAP 交换之后
acts.purpose: greet -> friends, private chat, the quiet rule, after-show chat room, album World Cup, 默契局, community, creation corner, memory card, My Space
acts.music: second groove proper from 55:1, highest energy; sticker-pop dings on beat 4 of every other bar; 8th-note fill in 72

acts.title: WHY IT MATTERS 为什么值得做
acts.purpose: one more layer after every live show (vision: QQ音乐 / 酷狗, labelled 设想); privacy, consent, fun; 「曲终，人不散。」; one person can try it now
acts.music: stop-time break 73-74 (hits on 1, 2.5, 3.5) + tom fill; final LIFT chorus from 75:1, a whole step up; 「曲终，」 on 79:1, the lift's fifth bar

acts.title: END CARD 片尾
acts.purpose: 「同一刻，另一面。」, MUSIC SPACE, link + QR, disclosure, music credit
acts.music: stop-time tag 83-84 (hits on 1, 1.75, 2.5); BIG END CHORD on 85:1 (the QR lands on it); final ding 88:1; ring out by 91:1
